title: Tokens, then polish: make the design tokens, then fix a finished screen with them

## Design system: Invoicing app Path a, from your colour. Archetype: precise-fintech. An invoicing product calls for precise, trustworthy numbers. ### Files - `/tmp/recipe-tokens-then-polish-ig4DB7/design-tokens.json`: the tokens in the standard W3C format - `/tmp/recipe-tokens-then-polish-ig4DB7/tokens.css`: CSS variables for light and dark mode - `/tmp/recipe-tokens-then-polish-ig4DB7/design-system-report.md`: the full report ### Colours kept | Input | Hex | Hue | Placed at | |-------|-----|-----|-----------| | primary | #0d9488 | 175° | primary-700 | The status colours use defaults because you didn't give any: success #16a34a, warning #d97706, danger #dc2626, info #2563eb. **Primary button:** white text on #0d9488 only reaches 3.74:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum. So the button uses primary-800 (#0b7067), a darker shade of the same teal, where white text reaches 5.95:1. Your #0d9488 itself is unchanged, at primary-700 and as `--color-brand`. ### Contrast The lowest ratio for each role, light and dark mode. 37 pairs were checked in each mode and all pass. | Text | On | Light | Dark | Needs | Result | |------|----|-------|------|-------|--------| | text-default | all 4 surfaces | 12.63:1 | 9.77:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | text-muted | all 4 surfaces | 5.72:1 | 5.79:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | text-link | all 4 surfaces | 5.23:1 | 6.30:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | selected-text | all 4 surfaces, selected-bg | 5.23:1 | 6.30:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | text-inverse | surface-inverse | 13.72:1 | 13.72:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | action-primary-text | action-primary-bg, -hover, -pressed | 5.95:1 | 5.95:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | success-text | surface-default, success-bg-subtle | 6.50:1 | 7.36:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | success-text-on | success-bg | 6.37:1 | 6.37:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | warning-text | surface-default, warning-bg-subtle | 7.89:1 | 6.77:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | warning-text-on | warning-bg | 4.52:1 | 4.52:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | danger-text | surface-default, danger-bg-subtle | 5.59:1 | 10.36:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | danger-text-on | danger-bg | 4.83:1 | 4.83:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | info-text | surface-default, info-bg-subtle | 6.65:1 | 7.50:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | info-text-on | info-bg | 5.17:1 | 5.17:1 | 4.5:1 | pass | | border-strong | surface-default, surface-subtle | 4.43:1 | 4.59:1 | 3:1 | pass | | border-focus | surface-default, surface-subtle | 3.57:1 | 8.84:1 | 3:1 | pass | ### How to use - Load `tokens.css` before your own styles. - By default the page follows the system's light or dark setting. To force one, set `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on the `` element. - **Scales:** spacing 0–64 px, type 12–30 px, body text 16 px with line-height 1.5, font weights 400 and 600. - **Sizes:** controls are 32, 40 or 48 px high, with every click area at least 44 px. Breakpoints are 640, 768, 1024 and 1280 px. ### Open questions - Button hover and pressed both use primary-900. Give pressed its own colour if they need to look different. --- ## UI polish: Invoice card 14 fixes across spacing, type, contrast, hierarchy, states, motion and tokens. The text and the brand's teal are unchanged. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: card `padding: 13px` is now `var(--space-12)`. 2. **Spacing**: heading margin `5px` is now `var(--space-4)`. 3. **Spacing**: the paragraph's margin is now `0 0 var(--space-16)`, and the second button gets `margin-left: var(--space-8)`. 4. **Spacing**: button `padding: 6px 10px` is now `var(--space-8) var(--space-12)`. 5. **Typography**: heading `22px` is now `var(--font-size-2xl)` (24 px), with `var(--line-height-heading)`. 6. **Typography**: paragraph `13px` is now `var(--font-size-md)` (16 px), with `var(--line-height-body)` and `max-width: var(--measure)`. 7. **Typography**: the page uses two font weights. The heading and buttons use `var(--font-weight-strong)` instead of the default bold 700. 8. **Contrast**: the paragraph's `#999999` on white is only 2.85:1. It now uses `var(--color-text-muted)` at 6.52:1. 9. **Contrast**: white text on the `#0d9488` button is 3.74:1. It now uses `var(--color-action-primary-bg)` with `var(--color-action-primary-text)` at 5.95:1. This is the same hue, just darker. 10. **Hierarchy**: there were two filled buttons. "Download PDF" is now an outline button using the secondary-action tokens. 11. **States**: hover, pressed, `:focus-visible` (a 2 px outline in `--color-border-focus`) and disabled styles are added. Both buttons get a minimum size of `var(--size-target-min)` (44 px). 12. **Motion**: the button's background transition uses `var(--duration-base)` and is turned off for users who prefer reduced motion. 13. **Tokens**: the card background, border colour and width, font family, and radii now use tokens. The 5 px radius becomes `var(--radius-md)` on the card and `var(--radius-control)` on the buttons. 14. **Tokens**: `tokens.css` is linked so the card picks up light and dark mode. ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Due date | #999999 on #ffffff, 2.85:1 | `--color-text-muted` (#4c6260) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 6.52:1; dark 10.12:1 | | Pay now | #ffffff on #0d9488, 3.74:1 | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--color-action-primary-bg` (#0b7067), 5.95:1; hover 11.29:1 | | Download PDF | #ffffff on #0d9488, 3.74:1 | `--color-action-secondary-text` (#0b7067) on `--color-surface-default`, 5.95:1; on hover 5.69:1; dark 11.01:1 | | Heading | #111827 on #ffffff, 17.74:1 | Kept as written, 17.74:1 (see Open questions) | The contrast script calculated all the ratios. ### Polished code Also saved at `/tmp/recipe-tokens-then-polish-ig4DB7/invoice-card.html`. ```html

Invoice 1042

Due on 30 November.

``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word, and the same elements. - The brand hue: #0d9488 is still the teal at 175°, and the buttons use darker shades of it. - The token file was not edited. ### Open questions - **The heading colour is the one raw value left, and it breaks in dark mode.** I kept `#111827` because it already passes in light mode (17.74:1). The polish rules don't swap a passing value for a token unless you approve it. The token `--color-text-default` (#212c2b) gives 14.39:1 in light mode. Leaving `#111827` means the heading is almost invisible in dark mode: 1.01:1 on the dark card. If you confirm, replace `color:#111827` with `color:var(--color-text-default)`, which gives 17.08:1 in dark mode. I'd recommend that.
